connector.name: MCP Gtags Server
connector.registryDescription: Indexed C/C++ code navigation for AI agents - GNU Global (gtags) lookups over MCP, not grep scans.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-gtags-server. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the harshithsunku account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: GTAGS_MCP_ROOT
env.description: Optional pinned project root. Usually unnecessary: the server uses the client's workspace roots or auto-detects the repo from its working directory.

env.name: GTAGS_MCP_AUTO_SETUP
env.description: Set to 0 to disable the automatic user-space install of the gtags/ctags toolchain on first use.
